transcript: the Gazillion Bubble Show is real I have seen it with my own two eyes I don't mean to ruin the fun of the mysterious off Broadway show but let's talk about it because it's actually kind of interesting so the mysteries here are you know why does no one ever talk about this show? has anyone actually seen it? why has it been able to run so long when no one talks about it? who is even in the show? why are the curtain times so weird? all of these questions can be answered pretty easily by a couple of key details foremost among them is that this is a show attended primarily by children and families that's why you never really hear anyone in the theatre community talking about it that's why the curtain times are all over the place and part of the reason they've been around so long I assume is because the show is incredibly cheap to run because there is in fact only one performer which I'll talk about in a second and outside of that I assume their biggest expense is bubble soap which is very cheap that leads us to the next mystery which is who is even *in* the gazillion bubble show well the show was created by Vietnamese Canadian bubble artist Fan Yang and he was the original performer in the show and since then show has become something of a family affair with different members of the Yang family taking over as the sole performer in the show over the years when I saw the show a couple years ago it was performed by Ana Yang who I believe is the wife of Fan Yang this is a legitimate bubble artist dynasty bubbles are the family business now if you're curious what the show is actually like I did talk about my experience in a video a couple years ago which I'll link in the caption but spoiler alert I did leave the show covered in bubble soap
